title: Presidential Decree No. 438, s. 1974
text:
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 438

FURTHER EXTENDING THE EFFECTIVITY OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 333, AS AMENDED, DATED NOVEMBER 26, 1973

As an emergency measure against the current international oil crisis, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers in me vested by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1, dated September 22, 1972, as amended, do hereby order and decree that the effectivity of Presidential Decree No. 333, as amended by Presidential Decree No. 343 and Presidential Decree No. 368 be further extended to a period of ninety (90) days from and after the date of the effectivity of this Decree.

This decree shall take effect immediately.

Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of April, 1974.

(Sgd.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS

By the President:

(Sgd.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR Executive Secretary

Source: Malacañang Records Office
